correctness.rationale: For the exact 16-cell row/column/2x2 block conflict graph with degree seven and 56 edges, independently enumerated all 65536 subsets and obtained 161 faces including empty (f-vector 16,64,64,16). Enumerated 32 actual elementary free-face/coface pairs; their removal leaves a pure two-dimensional simplicial subcomplex with 16 vertices, 48 edges and 32 triangles. Independent incidence checks verify connected one-skeleton, two triangles per edge, connected 2-regular link at each vertex and a globally coherent orientation. Its Euler characteristic 16-48+32=0 and surface classification identify an orientable genus-one torus. Elementary collapses imply simple-homotopy equivalence and the claimed integral homology, pi1=Z² and nonzero degree-one cup pairing.
residual_risks: The assertion concerns one-symbol placements in standard 4x4 Sudoku, NOT full Sudoku colorings and not arbitrary board sizes.

evidence: S. Goyal, S. Shukla, A. Singh, Homotopy Type of Independence Complexes of Certain Families of Graphs, arXiv:1905.06926, Proposition 3.2 / Theorem 5.1, covers categorical products of two complete graphs, not Sudoku NEPS/conflict graph.
T. Sander, Sudoku Graphs are Integral, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 16 (2009) N25, DOI 10.37236/263 computes Sudoku graph eigenvalues, not the topology of its independence complex.

value.rationale: A Sudoku board is a canonical finite constraint system, and the complex of all feasible placements of a single value is its natural solution-space topology. A collapse to a torus has nontrivial pi1 and cup product, qualitatively unlike known rook/chessboard wedges. The exact 32 elementary collapses make a reusable combinatorial-topology benchmark, though no result for 9x9 boards is claimed.
residual_risks: One fixed 4x4 board rather than a formula for general Sudoku block sizes.

limitations: Only the 4x4 one-symbol placement complex; no general Sudoku graph or full coloring space asserted.
An equivalent single-symbol Sudoku-complex torus computation under a different label may be unindexed.
